title: Seaside Rental Near Beach with Walkable Location
meta_description: Enjoy a central Seaside stay in this 3‑bedroom rental with easy beach access, open living space, and a short walk to shops and dining.
description_expanded: Prime Gulfside Location in Seaside, FloridaDragonfly boasts one of the most coveted beachside locations in Seaside, Florida—situated just one home back from the sand with stunning, unobstructed Gulf views from multiple balconies. Located only ten steps from the East Ruskin Pavilion beach access, one block from the Seaside Amphitheater and iconic Airstream Row, and moments from Bud & Alley’s, Heavenly Shortcakes, and Central Square, this home places you at the heart of Seaside’s coastal lifestyle. From sunrise coffee to glowing sunset skies, the Gulf is always in view—and always calling.Light-Filled Living with Front-Row Gulf ViewsEnter Dragonfly and step into a glass-surrounded great room where turquoise waters frame your every moment. Watch famous Gulf sunsets from the comfort of the sofa, fall asleep to the soothing sound of waves, or enjoy the twinkling lights of the East Ruskin Pavilion just beyond the windows at night. This elevated living space delivers a truly immersive Seaside experience—where the beach feels like an extension of the home.Three Private Suites for Relaxation and ComfortDragonfly offers three spacious bedroom suites, thoughtfully designed for families and groups.The second-floor king primary suite features sweeping Gulf views, a private balcony, and a spa-like en-suite bath with double vanity and marble shower.The first-floor king primary suite is ideal for late sleepers and includes a double vanity marble bath, a morning kitchen, and access to a screened porch. Also on this floor is a small countertop with a sink and microwave along with a mini-fridge for guest use.The third oversized suite is perfect for kids or additional guests, featuring two sets of double bunk beds, a play area, a 32-inch TV, and a private bath—comfortably sleeping four with room to unwind. (sleeps 4) Kitchenette with Coastal CharacterThe kitchenette offers the essentials for light meal prep and easy snacks, with a GE stainless steel dual-fuel range, a mini fridge, and an under-counter freezer. Vetrazzo recycled sea-glass countertops and dark stained wood floors add a coastal touch that complements the home’s Seaside charm. Please note: the kitchenette does not include a full-size refrigerator or freezer. With Seaside’s restaurants and markets just a short stroll away, it’s a convenient spot for morning coffee and quick bites between beach days.Modern Amenities with Classic Seaside StyleDragonfly is furnished locally to reflect the relaxed, timeless Seaside aesthetic while offering modern conveniences throughout. Enjoy DirectTV HD, a 46-inch LCD TV in the living room, 32-inch TVs in all bedrooms, DVD player, and Wi-Fi throughout the home. Two private off-street parking spaces provide added ease—rare for such a prime beachside location.A True Seaside OriginalOriginally one of Seaside’s cherished Anniversary Cottages, Dragonfly has been completely reimagined while preserving its simple, quaint, and cozy soul. Overlooking the charming Honeymoon Cottages and offering clear, effortless Gulf views from multiple vantage points, this home is the definition of a dream beach retreat. No leaning over railings—just pure ocean beauty, right in plain sight. Dragonfly is ready to welcome you and help you create unforgettable Seaside memories.5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESBeachside location with 1,512 square feet of living spaceJust 52 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessSeaside private residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion; largest private residential beach on 30ATVs in every bedroomMini-Refrigerator and under-counter freezer; please note this home does not have a full-size refrigerator or freezerPrivate parking for two cars in designated parking spots in front off street drivewayAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001889
